name: JellyFish Light
description: A whimsical ceiling light shaped after a jellyfish, built to bring a soft, playful glow into a room without leaning too far into novelty. The rounded, tapering silhouette mimics the gentle, floating form of a real jellyfish, making it a good fit for bedrooms, kids' rooms, or any space that wants a bit of personality in the lighting.
highlights: Rounded, jellyfish-inspired silhouette for a soft, playful glow
Works well as a standout piece rather than a purely functional fixture
A good fit for bedrooms, kids' rooms, or playful interior themes
installation: Once the file is installed and inZOI is running, open Build Mode and switch to the Lighting catalog. Search for "JellyFish" to find the piece, it is listed under that name in the build menu, not under "MOOSTYLES." If it does not show up, confirm the mod is enabled in your mod manager and that you are on the tracked game version listed above before reporting it as missing.
